answer: An identity locks a 40-credit bond and climbs a five-link challenge chain of key-signed, hash-linked answers. The zenith link opens after the four below verify. Each link emits a plume, a signed trail on-ledger. Links cost 70; one identity pays 110, so 1,000 fakes pay 110,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented climbers fail: a hired solver's key never matches, and the prism audit burns the bond. An honest agent pays 110 once, keeps its full share.
